job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>InMobi (Corporate)</strong></p> <p>InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.</p> <p><strong>InMobi Advertising</strong></p> <p>InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.</p> <p><strong>Glance</strong></p> <p>Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.</p></div><p><strong>Who are we and What do we do?</strong></p> <p>InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platform for marketers. Our platforms help Marketers reach 1.56 billion unique users through mobile to help them engage, acquire, re-engage, re-market and retain valuable users. InMobi is also India’s first unicorn and one of the only profitable global tech-product companies to emerge out of India.</p> <p>&nbsp;At 20+ offices across the globe, InMobi employs over 1000 personnel constituting 25 nationalities. Acclaimed for its culture, InMobi has consecutively featured on the Great Places to Work (GPTW) list, with a consistent hold in the Top 50 position for the past two years. Moreover, these accolades are not just restricted to India, InMobi has also secured a ranking on the GPTW’s 2017 China List, a notable feat for an Indian startup.</p> <p>InMobi has also regularly featured on world disruptor lists<strong> – </strong>MIT Technology Review’s 2013 50 Disruptive Companies; Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies for 2016, 2018; CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list of 2018, here InMobi was selected amongst a pool of more than 980 forward-thinking and ambitiou private companies across the globe, we now share this space with the likes of SpaceX, Airbnb, Uber and so on.</p> <p><strong>What is the InMobi family like? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise to challenges, the innovative products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that.</p> <p><strong>What can we promise? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your engineering skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a reliable, scalable, secure, and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on innovative technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader.</p> <p>Modern work environment, flexible schedule, and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams.&nbsp; Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym, or Yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.</p> <p><strong>What is the team like?</strong></p> <p class="p1"><strong>We are the CDR-AI team at InMobi, focused on building a next-generation Reporting, Analytics, and AI platform. Our mission is to transform raw data into actionable business insights for internal consumers while enabling seamless integration with multiple business and technology platforms.</strong></p> <p class="p1">As a platform team, we work closely with different lines of business across InMobi to understand their reporting, analytics, automation, and AI-driven decisioning needs. This gives the team a unique opportunity to solve high-impact business problems while working on large-scale data, analytics, and GenAI systems.</p> <p class="p1">In addition to reporting and analytics, the team is expanding into AI engineering areas such as <span class="s1"><strong>Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, and MCP-based integrations</strong></span>. We also work across cloud and AI platforms including <span class="s1"><strong>GCP, Microsoft Azure, databases, GKE, REST APIs, and modern deployment frameworks</strong></span>. Microsoft positions Azure AI as an enterprise-grade platform for building AI apps and agents, which aligns with the team’s direction toward scalable AI-led platform capabilities.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p class="p1"><strong>Key technology areas:</strong><br>AI/ML Engineering, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, MCP, Python, REST API Development, Spark, Java/J2EE, Airflow, Databricks, GKE, GCP, Microsoft Azure, Databases, Caching, Big Data Analytics.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What will you be doing?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as an independent senior engineer, owning complex problem statements and delivering scalable, reliable solutions aligned with business goals.</li> <li>Stay current with emerging technologies such as Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Copilot Studio, while mentoring the team on adoption and best practices.</li> <li>Collaborate with product, business, data, and engineering stakeholders, and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Participate actively in architecture discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, and technical decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What do we expect from you? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design and build LLM-powered applications, chatbots, copilots, and multi-agent workflows</li> <li>Implement GenAI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, or similar.</li> <li>Build and maintain prompt templates, chains, agents, tools, and reusable AI workflows.</li> <li>Integrate vector databases for semantic search, contextual retrieval, RAG, and memory.</li> <li>Develop backend services, REST APIs, and integrations to run AI models in production.</li> <li>Ensure AI solutions are explainable, accurate, compliant, secure, and aligned with finance policies.</li> <li>Monitor and evaluate model and workflow performance on an ongoing basis.</li> <li>Optimize inference cost, latency, reliability, and overall system efficiency.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Data, Business, Sales, Finance, and Engineering teams to deliver end-to-end AI solutions.</li> <li>Stay updated on emerging GenAI, AI/ML, agentic AI, and automation technologies.</li> <li>Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and architecture reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline.</li> <li>3–5 years of software development experience with hands-on expertise in <span class="s1"><strong>Python, SQL, TensorFlow/PyTorch</strong></span>, and modern AI/ML frameworks.</li> <li>Experience designing and building <span class="s1"><strong>LLM-powered applications</strong></span>, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector search, and fine-tuning pipelines.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with <span class="s1"><strong>agentic AI frameworks</strong></span> such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n, or ReAct-style agents. LangGraph is designed for customizable single-agent, multi-agent, and human-in-the-loop workflows. <span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Strong experience building <span class="s1"><strong>REST APIs, microservices, and backend systems</strong></span> for production-grade applications.</li> <li>Experience with <span class="s1"><strong>Model Context Protocol (MCP)</strong></span>, including building or integrating MCP tools, servers, or capabilities. MCP enables servers to expose tools that language models can invoke to interact with external systems such as APIs, databases, and computation services. <span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Good understanding of <span class="s1"><strong>CI/CD, Docker, and containerized application development</strong></span>. Docker provides a standard way to package and run applications in lightweight containers with their dependencies. <span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Working knowledge of <span class="s1"><strong>data pipelines, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms</strong></span> such as Azure, GCP, or AWS.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills, with the ability to work effectively in agile engineering environments.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>Nice to have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience of online advertising domain</li> <li>Experience of working on massively large-scale data systems in production environments</li> <li>Experience of Big Data analytics domain</li> <li>Experience of building AI products that are powered by data and insights</li> <li>Worked with Enterprise Applications like SaleForce, MS dynamics</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The InMobi Culture</strong></p> <p>At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.</p> <p>We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.</p> <p>We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.</p> <p>InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.</p> <p>Visit&nbsp;<a class="fui-Link ___1rxvrpe f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inmobi.com%2Fcompany%2Fcareers&amp;data=05%7C02%7Crichard.thomas%40inmobi.com%7Ce97eb886aa4d4c8e919608dc52d1cc2f%7C89359cf49e60409980c4775a0cfe27a7%7C0%7C0%7C638476308219536812%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=FOJ4DKK6f1jjlteD9SlK%2FdMDUaZzdYsCFSU%2BX%2BvuCAo%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank">https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers</a> to better understand our benefits, values, and more!</p></div>

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.</p> <p>Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-ads"><strong>Moloco Ads</strong></a> is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-commerce-media"><strong>Moloco Commerce Media</strong></a> enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.</p> <p>Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.</p> <p>Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We seek exceptional machine learning engineers to join us in building a state-of-the-art machine learning system. Moloco's ML system processes over 6 million bid requests per second at under 7ms prediction latency, and our deep learning models power CTR/CVR prediction, ranking, and bid price optimization for live auction decisions at planet scale. Moloco is an engineering company founded by top-tier engineers, and machine learning is the core of Moloco's engineering systems. We understand the value of a strong engineering team and strive to hire only the best engineers.</p> <p>As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will contribute to the full machine learning lifecycle — from model development and experimentation to data pipeline maintenance and production deployment. This role is designed for engineers who have solid machine learning and software engineering fundamentals, can execute end-to-end tasks with increasing independence, and are eager to grow through hands-on work in one of the most technically demanding real-time ML environments in the industry.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Develop and iterate on deep learning models for real-world prediction problems, including CTR/CVR estimation and ranking, with guidance on modeling choices and objective function design.</li> <li>Build and maintain data pipelines for model training and serving using GCP products such as Dataflow, BigQuery, BigTable, and open-source frameworks such as Apache Beam, PySpark, and Iceberg.</li> <li>Support production model serving, monitor model behavior in live environments, and contribute to debugging and improving model quality.</li> <li>Design and run offline experiments — define evaluation metrics, test hypotheses, and document findings to contribute to team-level modeling decisions.</li> <li>Collaborate with fellow Machine Learning Engineers, Applied Scientists, and Infrastructure engineers to deliver projects end-to-end within defined scopes.</li> <li>Grow your understanding of Moloco's AdTech domain — including auction mechanics, bidding systems, and advertising outcome modeling — and apply that context to your work.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Basic Qualifications (3 Titles)</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Machine Learning Engineer II</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li>2+ years of hands-on software development experience in machine learning or deep learning, with at least some exposure to production systems beyond academic or personal projects.</li> <li>Working knowledge of core machine learning modeling concepts, including classification and regression model selection, loss function design, bias/variance trade-offs, calibration, and offline evaluation.</li> <li>Solid foundation in statistics and probability, including conditional probability, common distributions, maximum likelihood estimation, hypothesis testing, and basic A/B test interpretation.</li> <li>Experience building or contributing to data pipelines or model serving systems, with an understanding of the engineering trade-offs involved.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, or Go.</li> <li>Fluent English communication skills.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Senior Machine Learning Engineer</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li>5+ years of hands-on software development experience in machine learning and deep learning, with a clear focus on production systems rather than research prototyping.</li> <li>Strong machine learning modeling depth, including model selection for classification, regression, and ranking, loss function design, calibration, class imbalance handling, and bias/variance trade-off reasoning.</li> <li>Solid foundation in statistics and probability, including Bayesian inference, maximum likelihood estimation, hypothesis testing, A/B experiment design and interpretation, and probabilistic reasoning under uncertainty.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience designing and operating large-scale machine learning systems under real-world constraints, including model-serving architectures, feature stores, and training pipelines.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, or Go, with the ability to write clean, robust, production-quality code.</li> <li>Fluent English communication skills.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Staff Machine Learning Engineer</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on software development experience in machine learning and deep learning, with a demonstrated focus on large-scale production systems.</li> <li>Proven track record of driving technical direction across teams or domains — not just executing projects, but defining the approach, resolving ambiguity, and influencing how others solve problems.</li> <li>Expert-level machine learning modeling depth, including objective function design, calibration, multi-task learning, ranking, and the ability to reason about trade-offs across the full modeling lifecycle.</li> <li>Strong foundation in statistics and probability, including Bayesian inference, causal reasoning, experiment design, and the ability to design and interpret complex A/B tests with confidence.</li> <li>Deep experience designing and operating large-scale machine learning systems end-to-end under real-world constraints, including model serving architectures, feature pipelines, retraining strategies, and observability.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, or Go, with the ability to write and review production-quality code as part of a team.</li> <li>Fluent English communication skills, including the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders at the leadership level.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <p><em>(We sincerely encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of the preferred qualifications.)</em></p> <ul> <li>Relevant experience in AdTech.</li> <li>MS or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science or related technical field</li> </ul> <p><strong id="docs-internal-guid-10b2a5c2-7fff-9123-b3ca-404b4268f3fb"></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. Through a lens of inclusion, we offer innovative benefits that empower our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can do the best work of their lives.</p> <p><strong>Moloco Values:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with Humility:</strong> Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. With humility, we become more open and accessible to each other. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Uncapped Growth Mindset:</strong> We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Create Real Value: </strong>We pursue the most impactful opportunities with rigor and integrity. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Go Further Together: </strong>We’re one team working towards one mission and vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Resources:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/blogs">Moloco Company Blog</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/leadership">Moloco Leadership</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/newsroom">Moloco Newsroom</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Use in Interviews</strong></p> <p>Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. Please review our <a href="https://www.moloco.cloud/hubfs/careers/AI%20Use%20in%20Interviews.pdf">AI Use in Interviews Policy</a> before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice:</strong></p> <p>Your privacy matters to us. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve reviewed our <a href="https://www.moloco.cloud/hubfs/careers/Candidate%20Privacy%20Notice.pdf">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div>

Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>What you’ll be part of</strong></h2> <p>Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.</p> <p>The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. When should we reach out, and how? — and the quality of those answers is determined by the algorithms behind them.</p> <p>This is not a dashboards or descriptive-analytics role. You will own production systems end-to-end: framing the problem, defining the objective function, choosing the right approach (ML, optimization, heuristics, expert systems, or a hybrid), shipping it, and improving it against real-world outcomes. The objective function, constraints, and tradeoff surface are all open design questions.</li> <li><strong>Member engagement model. </strong>Build an ML system that ingests claims data and in-app behavior to choose the right channel and moment for each touchpoint — SMS, push, phone, or email — to influence member behavior toward better-quality, lower-cost care.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A Bachelor's or Master's degree (in progress) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related STEM field, with an expected graduation date of Fall 2026 or Spring 2027.</li> <li>A bias toward action, quickly translating ideas into working prototypes to test approaches.</li> <li>Strong applied problem-solving skills, with the ability to define good metrics and then deliver solutions that improve them.</li> <li>A solid command of the methods your work calls for and the data your models depend on.</li> <li>Strong judgment in choosing between statistical models, heuristics, optimization approaches, and simpler algorithmic methods depending on the problem.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, with the ability to present your work clearly to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get here</strong></h2> <p>You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.</p> <p>At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Being a Dialer</strong></span><br><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. This role offers broad technical influence and the opportunity to shape how Dialpad operates real-time speech systems at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This position reports to our Senior Manager, AI Speech, and offers the opportunity to be based in our Canada Hub locations.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Self-Hosted Inference &amp; Scaling: Productionize and operate self-hosted speech models, optimizing serving architecture, resource utilization, concurrency, autoscaling, and cost so they can meet the demands of real-time voice agents.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Reliability, SLOs &amp; Observability: Build the monitoring, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and incident-response practices needed to meet uptime, latency, and quality SLAs for customer-facing speech systems.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Release &amp; Evaluation Infrastructure: Partner with Speech and MLOps engineers to enable shadow traffic, staged rollouts, model and artifact versioning, rollback-safe releases, and candidate-versus-incumbent comparisons.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Mentorship: Work closely with the MLOps (Inference) team and partner teams across speech, platform, telephony, and product to set technical direction, mentor engineers, and turn model advances into reliable production impact.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Skills you’ll bring</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Systems &amp; Backend Engineering: Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in Python, plus experience designing maintainable APIs, services, and integration layers. We’re open to candidates who are strongest in backend/platform engineering or who have grown from ML into systems.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Production ML &amp; Streaming: 5+ years of experience building or operating production software, including ML-backed systems, real-time services, speech applications, streaming media, or other latency-sensitive systems.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Model Serving &amp; Inference: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and troubleshooting ML models in production, including model serving, inference optimization, resource management, and safe model and version rollouts.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Cloud &amp; Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, as well as familiarity with containers, orchestration, service networking, CI/CD, and GCP.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Reliability &amp; Operations: Strong understanding of observability, alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and availability and latency SLAs for customer-facing systems.</span></li> <li><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to work closely with ML scientists, MLOps and inference engineers, and product teams, mentor teammates, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, reliability, latency, scale, and cost.</span></li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 14px;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">For exceptional talent based in </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">British Columbia, Canada</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;the target base salary range for this position is posted below. </span><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, 'Open Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;">Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>What you’ll be part of</strong></h2> <p>Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.</p> <p>The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Staff Machine Learning Operations Engineer</strong> to join our <strong>Platform</strong> <strong>Engineering team</strong>. This role will report to the <strong>VP of Platform Engineering</strong>. As Garner's foundational dedicated MLOps Engineer, you will assume responsibility for the reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency of our production machine learning systems. You will lead the development of a robust platform designed to facilitate the secure and consistent deployment of models by our machine learning and data science teams. Given that these models directly influence health outcomes and cost-effectiveness for millions of patients, maintaining the highest standards of production quality is imperative.</p> <h3><strong>Where you will work:</strong></h3> <p>This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you will do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the reliability, performance, functionality, and cost-efficiency of Garner's production ML systems, including establishing SLOs, observability, and on-call responsibilities.</li> <li>Architect Garner's ML platform including required data infrastructure (including feature store, model registry and CI/CD for models), and standardized service patterns.</li> <li>Implement ML-specific CI/CD pipelines: Transition our deployment process from manual notebook hand-offs to automated, PR-driven CI/CD workflows that include automated data quality checks and statistical model validation prior to deployment.</li> <li>Drive down cost and latency through improved architecture, hardware choices, and model optimization as appropriate.</li> <li>Lay the foundation for a future Garner MLOps team, including workflows, standards, and KPIs that enables rapid teammate onboarding and helps stakeholders and teammates quickly identify the health of the team’s products, allowing engineers to focus on areas where issues reside</li> <li>Establish Drift Monitoring: Design and implement automated data drift and concept drift monitoring systems that alert the team when models degrade, laying the groundwork for future Continuous Training (CT) architectures</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The ideal candidate has:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent operating ML or data-intensive systems in production at scale.</li> <li>Deep experience with the modern ML production stack: model serving (e.g., Sagemaker, Triton, or equivalent), feature stores, model registries, and CI/CD for ML.</li> <li>Strong infrastructure and platform engineering fundamentals: Kubernetes, containerization, cloud (AWS preferred), Terraform/IaC, observability, and incident response.</li> <li>Experience designing ML platforms or significant components of one (not strictly consuming SaaS) and the judgment to know when to build vs. buy.</li> <li>Strong collaboration with ML, data, platform engineers, data scientists, and product engineering teams, with the ability to set technical direction as the most senior MLOps voice in the org.</li> <li>Healthcare, regulated-data, or other high-stakes production ML experience is a plus but not required.</li> <li>A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll get here:</strong></h3> <p>You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.</p> <p>At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.</p> <h3><strong>Technologies we use:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Python, Kubernetes, AWS, Sagemaker, Terraform, S3, Snowflake, Airflow, Datadog</li> </ul> <p>This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Compensation Transparency:</strong></h3> <p>The target salary range for this position is $298,000 - $351,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k), Teladoc Health and more.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <h3><strong>Fraud and Security Notice:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use <a href="http://getgarner.com/">getgarner.com</a> and <a href="garnerhealth.com">garnerhealth.com</a> email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement <a href="https://www.ic3.gov/Home/ComplaintChoice">here</a> and to <a href="mailto:candidateprotection@getgarner.com">candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com</a>.</p> <h3><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity:</strong></h3> Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. <p>Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at <a href="mailto:talent@getgarner.com">talent@garnerhealth.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> </div></div>

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace &amp; defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy &amp; renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h3><strong>Note: </strong>We are currently recruiting for multiple positions, however please only apply for the role that best aligns with your skillset and career goals.</h3> <h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Delivery, you are an experienced problem solver and technical leader who stays anchored to impact. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, lead technical initiatives, and excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to embed cutting-edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.</p> <p>You’ve shipped ML systems end-to-end and at scale: you design, build and test reliable, scalable ML data pipelines; you know how to explore and manipulate 3D point-cloud and mesh data to enable geometry-aware modelling; you select the right libraries, frameworks and tools and make pragmatic product decisions that set Delivery up for success. Working at the intersection of data science and software engineering, you translate R&amp;D and project outputs into reusable libraries, tooling and products.</p> <p>With at least 3 years industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you're ready to not only execute but also lead and mentor others. job.description: <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Together AI is building the best inference infrastructure for voice applications. Our Voice AI platform powers production-grade, real-time voice agents and applications — serving speech-to-text and text-to-speech models with best-in-class latency and reliability.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff ML Engineer to drive the model serving layer for voice workloads. You'll work hands-on with inference engines like TRT-LLM and SGLang to optimize how we serve models like Whisper, Parakeet, Orpheus, and Kokoro — pushing latency and throughput to the frontier. You'll profile GPU utilization, design batching strategies for streaming audio, and ensure new model architectures can go from research to production quickly.</p> <p>This is a foundational hire on a small, high-impact team. Voice inference has unique challenges — streaming audio, tokenization, real-time latency budgets — that require dedicated ML engineering focus. You'll shape how Together serves voice models as the industry moves from pipeline architectures (ASR → LLM → TTS) toward end-to-end speech-to-speech.</p> <ul> <li>Own the model serving stack that powers Together's voice platform across STT, TTS, and speech-to-speech.</li> <li>Work directly with state-of-the-art accelerators (H100s, H200s, B200s) to optimize voice model inference.</li> <li>Collaborate with model partners (Cartesia, Deepgram, Rime, and others) to bring their models to production on Together's infrastructure.</li> <li>Build quality evaluation frameworks that guide model selection for customers and inform the roadmap.</li> <li>Join a small, early-stage team with outsized impact on a fast-growing product area.</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">&nbsp;</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Own the voice inference roadmap end-to-end — define and execute the technical strategy for optimizing STT, TTS, and speech-to-speech models across Together's infrastructure, with a clear-eyed view of where the field is heading and how to position the platform ahead of it.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Drive best-in-class inference performance — architect and implement systems targeting leading TTFB, throughput, and GPU utilization for voice workloads; set the performance bar others in the industry measure against, not just catch up to.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Lead productionization of voice models at scale — design the serving architecture for serverless and dedicated endpoints, including batching strategies, streaming inference pipelines, and memory management tailored to real-time audio; own reliability and latency SLAs.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Build the voice evaluation platform — design a rigorous, extensible evaluation framework covering WER across accents, languages, and noise conditions for STT; naturalness, latency, and pronunciation fidelity for TTS; establish the internal benchmark methodology that informs model selection and roadmap decisions.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Shape the architecture for next-generation model support — anticipate and enable emerging model paradigms — audio-native LLMs, codec-based architectures (SNAC, Encodec), and end-to-end speech-to-speech systems — before they're mainstream, not after.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Serve as the technical DRI for model partner integrations — lead deep collaboration with partners such as Cartesia, Deepgram, and Rime; own the full lifecycle from integration to optimization to ongoing performance accountability.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Diagnose and resolve the hardest performance problems in the stack — conduct systematic profiling and root-cause analysis from GPU kernel behavior to framework-level bottlenecks; drive shipped improvements with documented, measurable impact.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Influence platform architecture across the organization — partner with platform engineering leadership to ensure the serving layer is built for the latency and reliability demands of real-time voice APIs; your technical decisions should raise the ceiling for the whole team.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Define and scale voice fine-tuning capabilities — lead the technical direction for enabling customers to fine-tune STT and TTS models on Together's infrastructure, establishing the primitives for differentiated voice experiences.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Lay technical foundations for a category-defining product surface — architect systems with enough foresight that they support multiple new voice products with minimal rework; think in terms of platforms, not point solutions.</li> </ul> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]"><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">8+ years of ML engineering experience, with a demonstrated focus on model serving, inference optimization, or ML infrastructure at production scale — including systems you've owned from design through live traffic.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Deep, practical expertise in LLM serving engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalent) — you've modified engine internals, debugged edge cases under load, and contributed improvements back; you don't stop at the API surface.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Expert-level Python and PyTorch proficiency, with a strong command of GPU optimization — CUDA kernels, memory hierarchies, profiling toolchains — and a track record of turning that knowledge into shipped latency or throughput wins.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Proven system design judgment — you've made architectural decisions that held up at scale and influenced how a team or platform evolved; you can articulate the tradeoffs you made and why.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Strong technical leadership — you operate with high autonomy, define the right problems before solving them, and raise the bar for engineering quality around you without requiring process overhead.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Sharp product intuition for developer tooling — you understand what voice application developers actually need to ship great products, and you let that shape your technical priorities, not just the other way around.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Proven ability to move fast in ambiguous environments — you've thrived on early-stage or platform teams where scope is wide, ownership is deep, and the roadmap you build is the one you execute.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Strong foundation in speech and audio ML (ASR/TTS architectures, audio signal processing) — directly relevant experience is strongly preferred; exceptional ML engineering fundamentals with genuine curiosity about the domain is also considered.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Familiarity with audio codec and tokenization schemes (SNAC, Encodec, DAC) is a meaningful plus at this level.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience training or fine-tuning speech models at scale is a significant advantage.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field — or equivalent depth demonstrated through your work.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Together AI</strong></h3> <p>Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.</p> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $220,000 - $280,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.</p> <h3><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.</p> <p>Please see our privacy policy at <a href="https://www.together.ai/privacy">https://www.together.ai/privacy</a> &nbsp;</p>

experimentation and evaluation.</p> <p>We are looking to grow our team of AI Engineers, and are hiring at multiple levels.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build infrastructure for running large-scale agentic workloads, including multi-step agents interacting with tools, external services, sandboxes, and simulated environments</li> <li>Build scalable synthetic data generation and automated labeling systems that allow teams to create, refine, and evaluate high-quality training and evaluation datasets</li> <li>Design evaluation infrastructure for measuring AI system behavior across models, prompts, tools, environments, and multi-step trajectories - including reproducible experiments, benchmark execution, regression detection, and continuous evaluation</li> <strong>non-deterministic AI or ML workloads in production or at significant scale</strong> — you are comfortable reasoning about behavior across models, tools, environments, and multi-step variability</li> <li>Track record of leading complex engineering initiatives, influencing stakeholders, and delivering measurable impact</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strong technical communication skills</li> <li>Fluency with modern AI and developer tooling and a willingness to rapidly evaluate and adopt new models, frameworks, infrastructure, and techniques as the ecosystem evolves</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or operating LLM or agent infrastructure, including model gateways, agent runtimes, tool execution, generation, automated labeling, data refinement, or dataset quality systems</li> <li>Experience building reinforcement learning environments, agent simulations, benchmarks, or other environment-based evaluate, and productionize new AI systems. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.</p></div><hr> <p data-start="1774" data-end="2051"><strong>Overview of the Role:</strong></p> <p data-start="1774" data-end="2051">We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You’ll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.</p> <p>Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-ads"><strong>Moloco Ads</strong></a> is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-commerce-media"><strong>Moloco Commerce Media</strong></a> enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.</p> <p>Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.</p> <p>Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!</p></div><p><strong>The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Moloco NEXT is Moloco's performance advertising platform within Moloco. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on NEXT, you'll own the CTR/CVR prediction models inside a real-time bidding system that decides on every ad request in under 100ms.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a production CTR/CVR prediction model end-to-end — modeling, eval, feature pipelines, online experimentation, and post-launch ops. By month six, you'll own a meaningful slice of NEXT's ML stack.</li> <li>Hunt for the missing signals that move the needle: new data sources to log and ingest, derived and contextual features the current model doesn't yet see. On NEXT, most wins come from finding signals others missed — not from architectural cleverness.</li> <li>Run the loop fast: design offline evaluation, ship to online A/B, read out in days, iterate. Diagnose the offline-online divergences when they show up — and they will.</li> <li>Build the agentic tooling that automates parts of our experiment-debugging and signal-discovery workflow, both as a contributor and as a user.</li> <li>Set technical direction. Decide what NEXT should bet on next quarter, not just execute on assignments. Bridge to the data and pipeline teams whose signals feed our models — most signal-hunting wins depend on getting those teams aligned.</li> <li>Embrace the unglamorous parts: data-quality instrumentation, train/serve consistency in feature pipelines, slicing eval to find failure modes, and the careful experiment debugging that separates real wins from noise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of machine learning experience with a track record of shipping production-grade models in business-critical environments. We don't filter on degrees.</li> <li>Experience with data analysis</li> <li>Experience working on large-scale prediction or decisioning systems — CTR/CVR, ranking, recommendation, personalization, or related.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience writing code in Python</li> <li>Comfortable functioning under ambiguity</li> <li>Bonus: experience using LLMs as agents or feature extractors — especially in evaluation, experiment debugging, or signal-discovery contexts.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits </strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. Additionally, all employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO).</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The successful candidate may be eligible for a bonus and equity awards. Eligibility and amounts are determined by performance and the terms of the applicable plans. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The location for this role is listed above. For base pay range purposes, location-based compensation is grouped into the following regions. Your region is determined by your assigned work location.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Region A: </strong>Menlo Park Office, New York Office, SF Bay Area, New York Metro Area</span></li> <li style="font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Region B:&nbsp;</strong>Seattle Office, Seattle, Los Angeles/Orange County, San Diego, Austin, Boston, Washington DC Metro Area, Miami</span></li> <li style="font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Region C: </strong>All other U.S. locations</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Salary Ranges:</strong></span></p></div><div class="title">Region A:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$200,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$260,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Region B:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$180,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$235,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Region C:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$170,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$225,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. Through a lens of inclusion, we offer innovative benefits that empower our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can do the best work of their lives.</p> <p><strong>Moloco Values:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with Humility:</strong> Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. With humility, we become more open and accessible to each other. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Uncapped Growth Mindset:</strong> We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Create Real Value: </strong>We pursue the most impactful opportunities with rigor and integrity. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Go Further Together: </strong>We’re one team working towards one mission and vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Resources:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/blogs">Moloco Company Blog</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/leadership">Moloco Leadership</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/newsroom">Moloco Newsroom</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Use in Interviews</strong></p> <p>Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. Please review our <a href="https://www.moloco.cloud/hubfs/careers/AI%20Use%20in%20Interviews.pdf">AI Use in Interviews Policy</a> before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice:</strong></p> <p>Your privacy matters to us. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve reviewed our <a href="https://www.moloco.cloud/hubfs/careers/Candidate%20Privacy%20Notice.pdf">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div>

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Dialpad</strong><strong><br></strong>Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Being a Dialer</strong></span><br><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits:<strong> Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic</strong>.</span></p></div><h2><strong>Your role</strong></h2> <p>We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build the shared AI / ML platform that takes Dialpad’s model-backed capabilities from training through production inference.</p> <p>The AI / ML Platform team builds and operates GPU training infrastructure, model evaluation and lifecycle tooling, and production inference systems running on NVIDIA GPUs in GCP. We provide the common engineering foundations that allow ASR, NLP, and other AI teams to train, evaluate, release, operate, and continually improve models at enterprise scale.</p> <p>Inference is an important center of gravity for this role: turning trained models into reliable, observable, efficient production services. The work is intentionally end-to-end, however, because production outcomes are shaped by decisions made throughout the model lifecycle. You will work across training clusters, model artifacts, evaluation and release workflows, serving runtimes, production operations, and feedback loops.</p> <p>You will also serve as a senior engineering partner to ASR and NLP scientists. You will help teams reason about reproducibility, evaluation, scalability, hardware and runtime constraints, latency, reliability, cost, and release safety while there is still time to influence the design. You will not be expected to conduct original ML research, but you must understand training, data, evaluation, and model behavior well enough to help translate scientific work into dependable enterprise ML systems.</p> <p>This is an implementation-heavy engineering role, not an operations support position. You will build systems directly, lead substantial technical work, and improve the shared practices by which Dialpad moves AI capabilities from experimentation into production.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and improve shared platform capabilities spanning model training, evaluation, artifact management, release, production inference, and operational feedback.</li> <li>Build and operate shared GPU training infrastructure that provides scientists with reliable, reproducible, and efficient environments for model development and experimentation.</li> <li>Improve training-cluster scheduling, workload isolation, capacity management, storage, networking, observability, and accelerator utilization.</li> <li>Develop production-serving pathways for low-latency, high-throughput, and highly available inference workloads.</li> <li>Integrate and adapt model-training frameworks and inference runtimes to meet Dialpad’s requirements for automation, observability, security, and operational control.</li> <li>Improve the performance and efficiency of GPU workloads by reasoning across compute, memory, storage, networking, batching, concurrency, and workload scheduling.</li> <li>Partner with ASR and NLP scientists to translate evolving model capabilities into scalable production designs.</li> <li>Counsel scientific teams on production concerns including reproducibility, evaluation coverage, artifact design, resource requirements, serving feasibility, failure modes, and quality–performance trade-offs.</li> <li>Improve how models and related artifacts are versioned, traced, validated, compared, promoted, deployed, and rolled back across environments.</li> <li>Enable safe releases through representative evaluation, automated quality and performance checks, shadow traffic, staged rollouts, candidate-versus-incumbent comparisons, and fast rollback.</li> <li>Build benchmarking and evaluation infrastructure that measures model quality alongside latency, throughput, saturation behavior, reliability, resource utilization, and cost.</li> <li>Strengthen telemetry, structured logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and diagnostic tooling across training and production environments.</li> <li>Use performance data, incidents, developer feedback, and production model behavior to identify and deliver high-value improvements across the AI lifecycle.</li> <li>Reduce recurring manual work by building self-service workflows, clear interfaces, and practical standards that other AI teams can adopt.</li> <li>Lead technical projects from design through production operation, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor other engineers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Production engineering experience:</strong> Seven or more years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of backend, infrastructure, distributed, or ML platform systems in production.</li> <li><strong>ML systems experience:</strong> Experience building or operating systems that support model training, model inference, or the lifecycle connecting them.</li> <li><strong>Strong software fundamentals:</strong> Proficiency in Python, Go, or another backend-oriented language, with a record of producing maintainable production software and well-designed interfaces.</li> <li><strong>Cloud and Kubernetes fluency:</strong> Hands-on experience with Linux, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment automation, and production operations.</li> <li><strong>Accelerated-computing knowledge:</strong> Experience operating GPU workloads and reasoning about utilization, memory, storage, networking, scheduling, and workload performance.</li> <li><strong>Training familiarity:</strong> Working knowledge of modern model-training workflows, including datasets, experiments, distributed execution, checkpoints, reproducibility, and model artifacts.</li> <li><strong>Applied data-science fluency:</strong> An understanding of dataset quality, evaluation design, experimental validity, error analysis, model-quality metrics, and production model behavior sufficient to collaborate effectively with applied scientists.</li> <li><strong>Systems and performance judgment:</strong> The ability to find bottlenecks across system boundaries and make reasoned trade-offs among model quality, latency, throughput, reliability, capacity, and cost.</li> <li><strong>Operational judgment:</strong> A strong instinct for observability, repeatability, release safety, failure containment, rollback, and whole-system resilience.</li> <li><strong>Technical leadership:</strong> The ability to independently lead ambiguous projects, communicate clearly across disciplines, mentor engineers, and influence decisions through sound technical reasoning.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Particularly relevant experience</strong></h2> <p>You do not need experience with every technology or domain listed below. Experience in several of these areas would be especially valuable:</p> <ul> <li>ASR, speech processing, NLP, large language models, or other production model-backed systems.</li> <li>GPU-based or distributed model training.</li> <li>Model-serving runtimes such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, or comparable systems.</li> <li>Model-development frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.</li> <li>Kubernetes-based GPU scheduling and workload management.</li> <li>GCP infrastructure, particularly GKE and related storage, networking, and observability services.</li> <li>Experiment tracking, model evaluation, artifact registries, or production model monitoring.</li> <li>Building internal platforms for scientific and engineering users.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we work</strong></h2> <p>We treat an enterprise ML capability as more than a trained model. It includes the data and evaluation evidence behind the model; the infrastructure used to train it; the artifact and release process; the runtime and hardware on which it operates; and the telemetry, safeguards, and feedback loops required to operate and improve it.</p> <p>We favor practical, incremental improvements over unnecessary platform expansion. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>What you’ll be part of</strong></h2> <p>Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.</p> <p>The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking an exceptional Applied Scientist to join our Applied Science team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy the algorithmic systems that power Garner's products and drive meaningful impact for our members. Our members rely on us to answer hard questions — Which doctor should I see? What will it cost? When should we reach out, and how? — and the quality of those answers is determined by the algorithms behind them.</p> <p>This is not a dashboards or descriptive-analytics role. You will own production systems end-to-end: framing the problem, defining the objective function, choosing the right approach (ML, optimization, heuristics, expert systems, or a hybrid), shipping it, and improving it against real-world outcomes.&nbsp;The closest analog outside healthcare is a quantitative researcher at a top hedge fund.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the most ambiguous, high-stakes problems on the team end-to-end, and serve as a technical resource others rely on</li> <li>Frame messy, real-world healthcare and business constraints into clear objectives, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks</li> <li>Define the set of metrics needed to judge whether a solution is working, and validate solutions before they ship</li> <li>Choose the right approach for each problem, from machine learning to optimization to heuristics to simple rules, based on what the problem actually calls for</li> <li>Find novel ways to frame and solve the team's hardest problems, proving out approaches that others build on</li> <li>Set the bar for quality by reviewing others' work with rigor, and build the standards and evaluation tooling the team relies on</li> <li>Build a deep understanding of the healthcare economy and Garner's place in it</li> </ul> <p>To make the role concrete, here are three problems on our near-term roadmap:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Provider tiering optimization. </strong>Build a tiering algorithm that jointly optimizes geographic access and total-cost-of-care savings across our doctor network. The objective function, constraints, and tradeoff surface are all open design questions.</li> <li><strong>AI primary care doctor. </strong>Fine-tune and productionize an LLM-based primary care experience on our website, including the evaluation harness, guardrails, and ongoing quality monitoring needed to ship a medical-adjacent product safely.</li> <li><strong>Member engagement model. </strong>Build an ML system that ingests claims data and in-app behavior to choose the right channel and moment for each touchpoint — SMS, push, phone, or email — to influence member behavior toward better-quality, lower-cost care.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Research Scientist, or equivalent; or 2+ years of industry experience with a relevant advanced degree, PhDs preferred</li> <li>A bias toward action, quickly translating ideas into working prototypes to test approaches</li> <li>Strong applied problem-solving skills, with the ability to define good metrics and then deliver solutions that improve them</li> <li>Deep technical range, with fluency across Garner's data and a habit of staying current with advances in the field</li> <li>Strong judgment in choosing between statistical models, heuristics, optimization approaches, and simpler algorithmic methods depending on the problem</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to synthesize complex algorithmic ideas for senior and external stakeholders, and to secure buy-in for cross-team work</li> <li>A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll get here</strong></span></h2> <p>You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.</p> <p>At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Technologies we use:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Python, SQL, AWS, Snowflake, pandas, XGBoost, PyTorch, HuggingFace, modern LLM tooling and eval frameworks. We pick tools based on the problem, not the resume — bring your judgment.</p> </li> </ul> <p>This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.</p> <h3><strong>Compensation Transparency:</strong></h3> <p>The target base comp range for this position is <strong>$200,000 – $230,000</strong>.
