job.description: <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Together AI is building the best inference infrastructure for voice applications. Our Voice AI platform powers production-grade, real-time voice agents and applications — serving speech-to-text and text-to-speech models with best-in-class latency and reliability.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior ML Engineer to drive the model serving layer for voice workloads. You'll work hands-on with inference engines like TRT-LLM and SGLang to optimize how we serve models like Whisper, Parakeet, Orpheus, and Kokoro — pushing latency and throughput to the frontier. You'll profile GPU utilization, design batching strategies for streaming audio, and ensure new model architectures can go from research to production quickly.</p> <p>This is a foundational hire on a small, high-impact team. Voice inference has unique challenges — streaming audio, tokenization, real-time latency budgets — that require dedicated ML engineering focus. You'll shape how Together serves voice models as the industry moves from pipeline architectures (ASR → LLM → TTS) toward end-to-end speech-to-speech.</p> <ul> <li>Own the model serving stack that powers Together's voice platform across STT, TTS, and speech-to-speech.</li> <li>Work directly with state-of-the-art accelerators (H100s, H200s, B200s) to optimize voice model inference.</li> <li>Collaborate with model partners (Cartesia, Deepgram, Rime, and others) to bring their models to production on Together's infrastructure.</li> <li>Build quality evaluation frameworks that guide model selection for customers and inform the roadmap.</li> <li>Join a small, early-stage team with outsized impact on a fast-growing product area.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Optimize inference performance for voice models (STT, TTS, speech-to-speech) — targeting best-in-class TTFB, throughput, and GPU utilization across our curated model set.</li> <li>Productionize voice models on serverless and dedicated endpoints, including batching strategies, streaming inference, and memory management tailored to audio workloads.</li> <li>Build and maintain a voice model evaluation framework — measuring WER across accents, languages, and noise conditions for STT; naturalness, latency, and pronunciation accuracy for TTS.</li> <li>Enable new model architectures in our serving stack as the field evolves, including audio-native LLMs, codec-based models (SNAC), and speech-to-speech systems.</li> <li>Collaborate with model partners to integrate and optimize their models (Cartesia, Deepgram, Rime, and others) running on Together's infrastructure.</li> <li>Profile and debug performance across the full inference stack — from GPU kernels to framework-level bottlenecks — and ship measurable improvements.</li> <li>Work with the platform engineering side of the team to ensure the serving layer meets the latency and reliability requirements of real-time voice APIs.</li> <li>Contribute to voice model fine-tuning capabilities (STT and TTS) as we enable customers to build differentiated voice experiences on Together.</li> <li>Lay the groundwork for multiple new products down the line.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in ML engineering, with a focus on model serving, inference optimization, or ML infrastructure.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM serving engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or similar) — comfortable reading and modifying engine internals, not just using APIs.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch; experience with GPU profiling and optimization (CUDA, memory management, kernel-level debugging).</li> <li>Track record of shipping ML systems to production with measurable performance improvements.</li> <li>Strong product sense — you think about what developers building voice apps actually need, not just what's technically interesting.</li> <li>Comfort working on a small, early-stage team where you'll wear multiple hats and move fast.</li> <li>Experience with speech and audio ML (ASR, TTS architectures, audio signal processing) is a strong plus but not required — you can learn this quickly if you have strong ML engineering fundamentals.</li> <li>Familiarity with audio codecs and tokenization schemes (SNAC, Encodec, DAC) is a plus.</li> <li>Experience training or fine-tuning speech models is a plus.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Together AI</strong></h3> <p>Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.</p> <h3><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.</p> <p>Please see our privacy policy at <a href="https://www.together.ai/privacy">https://www.together.ai/privacy</a> &nbsp;</p>

Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.</p> <p><strong>InMobi Advertising</strong></p> <p>InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.</p> <p><strong>Glance</strong></p> <p>Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.</p></div><p><strong>Who are we and What do we do?</strong></p> <p>InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.</p> <p>Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-ads"><strong>Moloco Ads</strong></a> is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-commerce-media"><strong>Moloco Commerce Media</strong></a> enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.</p> <p>Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.</p> <p>Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!</p></div><h3>About the Role</h3> <p><strong>The impact you'll be contributing to Moloco:</strong><br>The Research Science (RS) team focuses on the operation and optimization of our software systems working closely with infrastructure engineering teams, machine learning teams and data science teams. As an Applied Scientist, you will participate as an individual contributor on research projects alongside other research scientists within the context of a group of cross functional collaborators working in complex multi-causal environments to identify inefficiencies, analyze potential options, and propose solutions. Your work will contribute to driving performance improvements and cost reductions, debugging and investigating production issues, and stabilizing our core system as you develop a deep end-to-end understanding of the system.</p> <h4>Here’s what you’ll be working on:</h4> <ul> <li>Work with other applied scientists on projects to evaluate the health of both internal and external components to make sure the Moloco system is running safely and efficiently.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Learn from your senior peers how to identify new areas to improve our infrastructure and machine learning components by understanding internal system changes, external changes, and data changes, and identify and suggest interesting/useful next steps for your projects.</li> <li>Complete task as part of larger projects to complete deep unbiased analyses.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Implement, and evaluate new algorithms and features in collaboration with senior Applied Scientists, Software Engineers and Machine Learning Engineers.</li> <li>Analyze massive, high-dimensional datasets from ad auctions and user interactions to uncover insights, define success metrics, and guide modeling and product decisions.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and other scientists to iterate on experiments, define roadmaps, and translate business requirements into scientifically sound solutions.</li> <li>Improve the reliability, latency, and efficiency of online prediction and decision systems by applying rigorous experimentation, monitoring, and continual model refinement.</li> </ul> <h4>Basic Qualifications:</h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or industry experience in optimization of market prices or ML systems</li> <li>At least 4 years of engineering or applied science experience</li> <li>Proficient verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to contribute to the creation of presentations and reports</li> <li>Quick understanding of new information and the demonstrated ability to learn new technical skills across engineering, machine learning, and data science&nbsp;</li> <li>Track record of building positive relationships with collaborators and stakeholders and working effectively with cross-functional partners in a global company</li> </ul> <p><strong id="docs-internal-guid-10b2a5c2-7fff-9123-b3ca-404b4268f3fb"></strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits </strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. Additionally, all employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO).</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The successful candidate may be eligible for a bonus and equity awards. Eligibility and amounts are determined by performance and the terms of the applicable plans. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The location for this role is listed above. For base pay range purposes, location-based compensation is grouped into the following regions. Your region is determined by your assigned work location.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Region A: </strong>Menlo Park Office, New York Office, SF Bay Area, New York Metro Area</span></li> <li style="font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Region B:&nbsp;</strong>Seattle Office, Seattle, Los Angeles/Orange County, San Diego, Austin, Boston, Washington DC Metro Area, Miami</span></li> <li style="font-size: 16px;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Region C: </strong>All other U.S. locations</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Salary Ranges:</strong></span></p></div><div class="title">Region A:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$188,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$235,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Region B:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$169,200</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$211,500 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Region C:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$159,800</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$199,750 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>What you’ll be part of</strong></h2> <p>Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.</p> <p>The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role<br></strong></h2> <p>We are seeking an exceptional Staff Applied Researcher to join our Applied Science team. You will be responsible for building the algorithmic systems that power Garner — determining how we evaluate providers, make recommendations, and optimize for outcomes across cost, quality, and access.</p> <p>You will be responsible for turning ambiguous, real-world problems into systems that deliver measurable impact, defining the objective functions, metrics, and logic that drive our product. You will own these systems end-to-end, from problem definition through production and ongoing performance.</p> <h2><strong>Where you will work:</strong></h2> <p>This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the most ambiguous, high-stakes problems facing the company end-to-end, and set how the team frames and approaches them</li> <li>Frame messy, real-world healthcare and business constraints into clear objectives, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks</li> <li>Define the set of metrics needed to judge whether a solution is working, and validate solutions before they ship</li> <li>Choose the right approach for each problem, from machine learning to optimization to heuristics to simple rules, based on what the problem actually calls for, and set the standard for how the team selects and applies these approaches</li> <li>Deliver algorithmic breakthroughs that move the company's most important metrics, pioneering approaches that become how applied science is done at Garner</li> <li>Review applied science work at the highest level across the company, ensuring the methods used across teams are sound and correctly applied</li> <li>Build a deep understanding of the healthcare economy and Garner's place in it</li> </ul> <p>To make the role concrete, here are three problems on our near-term roadmap:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Provider tiering optimization. </strong>Build a tiering algorithm that jointly optimizes geographic access and total-cost-of-care savings across our doctor network. The objective function, constraints, and tradeoff surface are all open design questions.</li> <li><strong>AI primary care doctor. </strong>Fine-tune and productionize an LLM-based primary care experience on our website, including the evaluation harness, guardrails, and ongoing quality monitoring needed to ship a medical-adjacent product safely.</li> <li><strong>Member engagement model. </strong>Build an ML system that ingests claims data and in-app behavior to choose the right channel and moment for each touchpoint — SMS, push, phone, or email — to influence member behavior toward better-quality, lower-cost care.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <h2><strong>The ideal candidate has:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>6+ years of industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Research Scientist, or equivalent; or 4+ years of industry experience with a relevant advanced degree, PhDs preferred</li> <li>A bias toward action, quickly translating ideas into working prototypes to test approaches</li> <li>Strong applied problem-solving skills, with the ability to define good metrics and then deliver solutions that improve them</li> <li>Recognized technical authority, with the judgment to ensure the techniques used across an organization are sound</li> <li>Strong judgment in choosing between statistical models, heuristics, optimization approaches, and simpler algorithmic methods depending on the problem</li> <li>Strong communication skills, including at the executive level, with a track record of driving alignment across an organization</li> <li>A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get here</strong></h2> <p>You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.</p> <p>At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.</p> <h2><strong>Technologies we use</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Python, SQL, AWS, Snowflake, pandas, XGBoost, PyTorch, HuggingFace, modern LLM tooling and eval frameworks. We pick tools based on the problem, not the resume — bring your judgment.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why this role</strong></h2> <p>This is a unique opportunity to work on high-impact search problems in healthcare, helping shape how members find better care through algorithmic systems that directly influence healthcare outcomes.</p> <h2><strong>Compensation Transparency:</strong></h2> <p>The target base comp range for this position is <strong>$260,000 – $382,000</strong>. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health and more.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <h3><strong>Fraud and Security Notice:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use <a href="http://getgarner.com/">getgarner.com</a> and <a href="garnerhealth.com">garnerhealth.com</a> email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement <a href="https://www.ic3.gov/Home/ComplaintChoice">here</a> and to <a href="mailto:candidateprotection@getgarner.com">candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com</a>.</p> <h3><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity:</strong></h3> Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. <p>Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at <a href="mailto:talent@getgarner.com">talent@garnerhealth.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> </div></div>

The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace &amp; defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy &amp; renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><div> <h3><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h3> <div> <p>As a Principal Data Scientist (Algorithm Engineer) in Delivery, you are an experienced problem solver and technical leader who is passionate about building practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, lead technical initiatives, and excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to embeds cutting edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.</p> <p>You've consistently tackled difficult problems that require strong foundations in data driven modelling and deep learning techniques, with extensive hands-on experience in probabilistic methods and predictive modelling. Your expertise in python, along with advanced proficiency in libraries like NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, TensorFlow and PyTorch, is essential, with proven ability to architect and deploy scalable, production-ready models and data pipelines.</p> <p>With industry experience (post Masters of PhD) in a commercial, you're ready to not only execute but also lead and mentor others. You're truly excited about growing both your technical expertise and leadership skills, naturally taking ownership of complex data science work streams and guiding teams to success. You continuously improve the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.</p> </div> <h3><strong>This Role</strong></h3> <div> <p>In this role, you'll work closely with our Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving, while providing technical leadership to your team.</p> <p>You'll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:</p> <ul> <li>Leading pre-processing and analysis of complex data to prepare it for use in predictive modelling, establishing best practices and methodologies for your team.</li> <li>Architecting and developing innovative deep learning models in combination with state-of-the-art optimisation methods to predict and control the behaviour of physical systems.</li> <li>Taking full responsibility for the quality, accuracy and impact of your work and the work of your team.</li> <li>Designing, building, and testing data pipelines that are reliable, scalable, and robustlyeasily deployable in production environments.</li> <li>Leading cross-functional collaboration with simulation engineers to ensure seamless integration of data science models with simulations.</li> <li>Driving internal R&amp;D and product development, helping to refine models and identify new areas of application.</li> <li>Mentoring junior team members and providing technical guidance to help them grow.</li> <li>Leading open communication and presentations with both technical teams and customers, helping onboard users and co-develop with customers.</li> <li>Representing PhysicsX as a technical authority when traveling to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, an average of 2-3 weeks per quarter, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on site.</li> </ul> <p>As a senior member of the team, you'll have significant influence on our technical direction and the opportunity to shape future solutions and products, while developing your skills as a technical leader.</p> </div> <h4><strong>Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions -&nbsp;<a href="https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world" target="_blank">read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!</a></strong></h4> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics.&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We collect diversity and inclusion data solely for the purpose of monitoring the effectiveness of our equal opportunities policies and ensuring compliance with employment and equality legislation. This information is confidential, used only in aggregate form, and will not influence the outcome of your application.&nbsp;</div> <div> <div class="body body__secondary"> <div id="question_7460024101-description" class="question-description"></div> </div> </div> <div> <div class="select">&nbsp;</div> </div></div>

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>InMobi (Corporate)</strong></p> <p>InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.</p> <p><strong>InMobi Advertising</strong></p> <p>InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.</p> <p><strong>Glance</strong></p> <p>Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview:</strong></p> <p>We are hiring a Tech Lead / SDE IV to anchor and grow our Data Engineering capability within our Demand-Side Platform (DSP). This is a high-impact, technically hands-on leadership role at the intersection of real-time data infrastructure, programmatic advertising, and scalable backend systems. You will own the design and delivery of pipelines that power bidding intelligence, audience targeting, campaign analytics, and attribution — processing billions of bid-stream events daily. Alongside your data engineering mandate, you will architect and contribute to backend microservices that sit at the core of our DSP stack, including integrations with SSPs, ad exchanges, and identity resolution platforms. You will mentor a team of engineers, drive technical direction, and collaborate closely with product, ML, and growth functions to turn data into a true competitive advantage.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Data Stack</strong> </span> <ul> <li>Design and own end-to-end data pipelines — batch and real-time — handling bid requests, win/loss events, impression logs, click streams, and conversion signals at scale.</li> <li>Build and maintain our data lakehouse architecture (ingestion → storage → serving layer) optimized for low-latency DSP analytics and ML feature generation.</li> <li>Define standards for data quality, lineage, observability, and SLA adherence across all data products.</li> <li>Own and evolve our StarRocks deployment for real-time analytical queries — schema design, ingestion patterns, and query optimisation for DSP reporting workloads.</li> <li>Drive FinOps discipline across the data platform — track compute and storage costs, enforce resource quotas, identify optimisation opportunities, and report on unit economics.</li> <li>Establish and lead Data Governance practices: metadata management, data cataloguing, access control policies, PII classification, and data retention standards compliant with GDPR and CCPA.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Backend Microservices</span></strong> <ul> <li>Contribute to and review the design of backend services that power DSP functionality — bid shading, pacing, budget management, and reporting APIs.</li> <li>Architect data contracts and event schemas between microservices, ensuring consistency across the bid request lifecycle.</li> <li>Champion best practices in API design, service reliability (SLOs, circuit breakers, retries), and observability (distributed tracing, structured logging, metrics).</li> <li>Collaborate with the bidder team on low-latency data reads (Aerospike, Cassandra, or similar) for real-time targeting signal lookups</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Technical Leadership</span></strong> <ul> <li>Lead architecture reviews, set engineering standards, and drive adoption of best practices across the data and backend engineering teams.</li> <li>Mentor SDE II/III engineers through code reviews, design sessions, and pair programming; grow the next generation of technical leaders.</li> <li>Partner with ML engineers on the full model lifecycle — feature engineering pipelines, offline training data generation, experiment tracking, and model serving infrastructure.</li> <li>Translate complex business requirements (campaign KPIs, ROAS, viewability, brand safety) into robust technical designs.</li> <li>Own the technical roadmap for data infrastructure — capacity planning, migration strategies, and build vs. buy decisions.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience &amp; Education</strong> <ul> <li>8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on data engineering or large-scale data systems.</li> <li>Prior experience in ad-tech, programmatic advertising, or real-time bidding (RTB) environments strongly preferred.</li> <li>Experience in ML engineering, feature engineering, building offline training pipelines, or collaborating closely on model productionisation — is preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Data Engineering (Core)</strong> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in distributed stream processing frameworks — Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, or Apache Spark Structured Streaming.</li> <li>Strong command of SQL and experience optimizing complex analytical queries at petabyte scale.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with real-time analytical databases, particularly StarRocks; familiarity with Snowflake or ClickHouse is a plus.</li> <li>Proficiency with workflow orchestration tools: Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.</li> <li>Solid understanding of data modelling — dimensional modelling, OBT patterns, and eventdriven schemas relevant to ad impression and attribution data.</li> <li>Familiarity with open table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Backend &amp; Systems:</strong> <ul> <li>Proficiency in Python (primary) and/or Java/Scala for building production-grade services and data processing jobs.</li> <li>Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and/or gRPC-based microservices.</li> <li>Working knowledge of low-latency data stores (Aerospike, Cassandra) used for real-time lookups in the bidding path.</li> <li>Comfortable with containerised deployments on Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar).</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Collaboration:</strong> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience leading technical squads or functioning as a technical anchor on cross-functional projects.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical complexity for nonengineering stakeholders.</li> <li>Track record of driving projects from ambiguous requirements to production with high engineering quality</li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The InMobi Culture</strong></p> <p>At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.</p> <p>We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.</p> <p>We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.</p> <p>InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.</p> <p>Visit&nbsp;<a class="fui-Link ___1rxvrpe f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inmobi.com%2Fcompany%2Fcareers&amp;data=05%7C02%7Crichard.thomas%40inmobi.com%7Ce97eb886aa4d4c8e919608dc52d1cc2f%7C89359cf49e60409980c4775a0cfe27a7%7C0%7C0%7C638476308219536812%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=FOJ4DKK6f1jjlteD9SlK%2FdMDUaZzdYsCFSU%2BX%2BvuCAo%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank">https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers</a> to better understand our benefits, values, and more!</p></div>

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.</p> <p>Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-ads"><strong>Moloco Ads</strong></a> is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-commerce-media"><strong>Moloco Commerce Media</strong></a> enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.</p> <p>Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.</p> <p>Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!</p></div><h2><strong>The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco</strong></h2> <p>Moloco is building the next generation of AI-powered creative optimization.</p> <p>As a Group Product Manager, you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of Moloco's most strategic AI investments. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, machine learning, experimentation, creative intelligence, and advertising performance to build products that transform creative signals into measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>This is a highly ambiguous, 0-to-1 opportunity that requires strong product judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to create clarity in an emerging space where customer needs, technical capabilities, and market expectations are evolving rapidly.</p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and drive the product strategy for AI-powered creative generation, optimization, and learning systems.</li> <li>Define how creative quality, advertiser outcomes, and AI system performance should be measured, evaluated, and optimized.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineering and machine learning teams to translate emerging technical capabilities into differentiated customer value.</li> <li>Use customer insights, experimentation, product intuition, and market signals to identify opportunities and guide investment decisions.</li> <li>Drive product discovery in areas with limited precedent, rapidly testing hypotheses and refining strategy based on new learnings.</li> <li>Influence stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership to align on vision, priorities, and execution.</li> <li>Partner with GTM teams to shape customer narratives, proof-of-concepts, adoption strategies, and feedback loops.</li> <li>Help define how Moloco brings AI-powered creative optimization to market and establishes leadership in this emerging category.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>This is a rare opportunity to own an early-stage product area at the center of one of the most significant shifts in advertising.</p> <p>The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and enjoys tackling problems that do not yet have established solutions. This is not a maintenance or optimization-focused PM role. Success will require creating structure where there is limited data, forming conviction without overfitting to incomplete signals, and helping the organization make high-quality decisions in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.</p> <p>You will have the opportunity to shape both the product strategy and the category itself as Moloco defines the future of AI-powered creative optimization.</p> <h2><strong>How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading 0-to-1 or highly ambiguous product initiatives where the problem space, customer needs, or technical capabilities were still emerging.</li> <li>You are comfortable creating clarity and direction when there is limited data, incomplete information, or no established playbook.</li> <li>You have strong product fundamentals, including customer obsession, prioritization, experimentation, metric design, decision making, and end-to-end ownership.</li> <li>You use data, research, customer feedback, and product judgment to make decisions, while recognizing that not every important decision can wait for perfect evidence.</li> <li>You can develop a strong point of view on product strategy and communicate it effectively to diverse stakeholders, including senior leaders and highly technical teams.</li> <li>You have experience building products in technically complex domains, working closely with engineering, machine learning, or data science teams to translate emerging capabilities into customer value.</li> <li>You have led strategic initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders, building alignment and momentum even when priorities, incentives, or data were not fully aligned.</li> <li>You are energized by rapid learning and enjoy exploring new technologies, customer behaviors, and market opportunities.</li> <li>You can balance long-term vision with pragmatic execution, making progress in uncertain environments while continuously refining strategy based on new learnings.</li> <li>You have experience partnering with go-to-market teams to shape product narratives, customer education, proof-of-concepts, feedback loops, and adoption strategies.</li> <li>You have strong customer instincts and can deeply understand user workflows, motivations, and pain points, even in unfamiliar domains.</li> <li>You are excited by the challenge of balancing customer needs, business outcomes, and emerging AI capabilities in areas where there is often no obvious right answer.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building AI-powered products, particularly Generative AI, machine learning, or recommendation systems.</li> <li>Experience with creative tools, content creation workflows, visual intelligence, or multimodal AI systems.</li> <li>Experience designing experimentation, measurement, or optimization systems.</li> <li>Experience in advertising, marketing technology, marketplaces, search, recommendation, or other data-driven decision systems.</li> </ul> <p>You do not need prior adtech experience to be successful in this role. We are looking for product leaders who can learn quickly, reason rigorously, and help define the future of AI-powered creative optimization.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits </strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>InMobi (Corporate)</strong></p> <p>InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.</p> <p><strong>InMobi Advertising</strong></p> <p>InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.</p> <p><strong>Glance</strong></p> <p>Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.</p></div><p><strong>What is the InMobi family like?&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise to challenges, the innovative products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What can we promise?&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your ML and AI skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a reliable, scalable, secure, and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on innovative technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Modern work environment, flexible schedule, and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams.&nbsp; Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym, or yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What is the team like?</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>At InMobi Enterprise team, we are transforming the way finance, sales, marketing, people, and legal functions operate.&nbsp;We’re driving transformative work across&nbsp;<strong>Sales, Marketing, People, and Finance</strong>&nbsp;with&nbsp;<strong>ML and</strong> <strong>Agentic AI</strong>—and we’re looking for passionate innovators to join us!</p> <p><strong>What you will be doing</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Data Scientist who can operate at the intersection of&nbsp;<strong>classical machine learning</strong>,&nbsp;<strong>GenAI</strong> and&nbsp;<strong>modern agentic AI systems </strong>with a strong engineering appetite. You will build and deploy intelligent AI/ML systems that will help transform the business process across the core. This role blends deep ML craftsmanship with forward-looking innovation in autonomous/agentic systems.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the experimentation, design and build of<strong> agentic AI systems</strong>&nbsp;that autonomously observe model performance, trigger experiments, tune hyperparameters, improve ranking policies, or orchestrate ML workflows with minimal human intervention.</li> <li>Apply&nbsp;<strong>LLMs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented architectures, and multimodal generative models</strong>&nbsp;for semantic understanding, content classification, and user preference modeling.</li> <li>Design intelligent agents that can automate repetitive decision-making tasks—e.g., candidate generation tuning, feature selection, or context-aware content curation.</li> <li>Support POCs/ Pilots projects to explore and validate innovative technologies and solutions in ML/AI space.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Build and operate machine learning models on diverse, high-volume data sources for forecasting, classification and prediction.</li> <li>Develop rapid experimentation workflows to validate hypotheses and measure real-world business impact.</li> <li>Design pipelines for data preparation, model training, evaluation, and deployment in collaboration with engineering counterparts.</li> <li>Define best practices for monitoring ML model performance using statistical techniques; identifying drifts, failure modes, and improvement opportunities.</li> <li>Contribute to ML/AI thought leadership—blogs, case studies, internal tech talks, and industry conferences.</li> <li>Thrive in a multi-functional, highly collaborative team environment with engineering, product, business, and creative teams.</li> <li>Interface with stakeholders across Product, Business, Data, and Infrastructure to align ML initiatives with strategic priorities.</li> <li>Document designs, development processes, and best practices to promote knowledge sharing and operational efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What do we expect from you?</strong></p> <p>We are seeking candidates with deep expertise in ML and hands-on experience building GenAI and Agentic AI systems.</p> <p><strong>Skillset: AI/ML Engineering, Python, LLM, RAG, Agentic AI, MCP, REST API</strong></p> <p>You should have experience with:</p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and deploy building LLM-powered applications, chatbots, and multi-agent systems to improve efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making.</li> <li>Implement and customize GenAI and multi-agent systems using AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar.</li> <li>Create, refine, and maintain prompt templates, chains, and workflows.</li> <li>Integrate vector databases (MilvusDB, FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, etc.) for semantic search and memory.</li> <li>Classical ML and deep learning techniques across NLP, clustering, and time series.</li> <li>Proficient in deploying ML workflows/models in production system. Continuous monitoring, evaluation, and retraining of models to ensure sustained performance. Ensuring model explainability, accuracy, compliance.</li> <li>Big data processing (Spark, distributed data systems) and cloud computing.</li> <li>Designing end-to-end ML solutions—from prototype to production.</li> <li>Stay updated with emerging AI/ML technologies and recommend relevant innovations for the finance domain.</li> <li>Drive in design reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.</li> <li>Collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders, including technical teams and business leaders.</li> <li>Adapting to fast-paced environments and evolving priorities with high energy and autonomy.</li> </ul> <p>We value curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a strong bias toward experimentation and production impact.</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Analytics, or related fields. PhD is a plus.</li> <li>8+ years of industry experience in ML/Data Science, with deep proficiency in Python and one or more frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn.</li> <li>Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, regression, tree-based models, clustering, and time series.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLMs, retrieval systems, generative models, or agentic/autonomous ML systems is highly desirable.</li> <li>Experience building Agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n or ReACT-style agents.</li> <li>Expertise with algorithms in NLP, Time Series, and Deep Learning, applied on real-world datasets.</li> <li>Strong experience with the big data ecosystem (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP/Vertex AI).</li> <li>Experience with Model Context Protocols (MCPs) — building or integrating MCP tools, servers, or capabilities.</li> <li>Comfortable working in cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to work in agile environments.</li> <li>Good understanding of data pipelines, APIs, and cloud platforms (Azure/GCP/AWS).</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The InMobi Culture</strong></p> <p>At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.</p> <p>We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.</p> <p>We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.</p> <p>InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.</p> <p>Visit&nbsp;<a class="fui-Link ___1rxvrpe f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inmobi.com%2Fcompany%2Fcareers&amp;data=05%7C02%7Crichard.thomas%40inmobi.com%7Ce97eb886aa4d4c8e919608dc52d1cc2f%7C89359cf49e60409980c4775a0cfe27a7%7C0%7C0%7C638476308219536812%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=FOJ4DKK6f1jjlteD9SlK%2FdMDUaZzdYsCFSU%2BX%2BvuCAo%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank">https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers</a> to better understand our benefits, values, and more!</p></div>

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.</p> <p>Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-ads"><strong>Moloco Ads</strong></a> is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. <a href="https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-commerce-media"><strong>Moloco Commerce Media</strong></a> enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.</p> <p>Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.</p> <p>Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!</p></div><h4><strong>Mission of the Role</strong></h4> <p>Ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of Moloco’s services by conducting rigorous manual testing and building AI Agent-driven automated testing frameworks. The QA Engineer will balance hands-on exploratory testing with modern AI technologies to write test cases, analyze failures, and optimize testing pipelines. By working closely with Software Engineers, you will improve product quality, development efficiency, and release confidence.</p> <h4><strong>What You will Do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Conduct thorough manual testing for new features, complex edge cases, and user-centric scenarios to ensure high product quality before release.</li> <li>Design, build, and scale an AI Agent-assisted test automation framework to transition repetitive manual tests into automated integration and end-to-end tests.</li> <li>Utilize AI Agents for automated test generation, script maintenance (auto-healing), and enhancing exploratory testing.</li> <li>Analyze bugs and errors found during both manual and automated testing, and communicate actionable findings (repro steps, root-cause insights) to Software Engineers.</li> <li>Choose the appropriate testing strategy for each service or feature, balancing manual testing, automation, regression coverage, and release risk.</li> <li>Integrate AI-driven QA tooling into CI/CD pipelines to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle.</li> <li>Improve development efficiency and performance by identifying quality risks early and integrating QA into the development process.</li> <li>Work closely with Software Engineers to enhance and improve programs, testability, and release quality.</li> <li>Maintain clear test documentation, defect records, and guidelines to ensure seamless QA operations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?&nbsp;</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with software-testing coursework or at least one year of software-testing experience.</li> <li>Basic understanding of Agile/DevOps software development practices and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).</li> <li>Strong attention to detail with a proven ability to identify edge cases, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, and gaps in requirements through manual testing.</li> <li>Familiarity with API testing, backend service verification, frontend testing.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Korean.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h4><strong>Preferred Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience or strong interest in leveraging AI tools/LLM Agents for QA processes (e.g., automated test script generation, auto-healing, log analysis).</li> <li>Familiarity with Jira or comparable test-management and issue-tracking tools.</li> <li>Familiarity with security/penetration testing concepts.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong id="docs-internal-guid-10b2a5c2-7fff-9123-b3ca-404b4268f3fb"></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. Through a lens of inclusion, we offer innovative benefits that empower our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can do the best work of their lives.</p> <p><strong>Moloco Values:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with Humility:</strong> Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. With humility, we become more open and accessible to each other. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Uncapped Growth Mindset:</strong> We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Create Real Value: </strong>We pursue the most impactful opportunities with rigor and integrity. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Go Further Together: </strong>We’re one team working towards one mission and vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Resources:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/blogs">Moloco Company Blog</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/leadership">Moloco Leadership</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.moloco.com/newsroom">Moloco Newsroom</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Use in Interviews</strong></p> <p>Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. Please review our <a href="https://www.moloco.cloud/hubfs/careers/AI%20Use%20in%20Interviews.pdf">AI Use in Interviews Policy</a> before your interview to understand what to expect. job.description: <h3>Role</h3> <p>At Samaya, our mission is to move users from information to conviction by delivering insights in a speedy, accurate, auditable, and verifiable manner. We are looking for a Product Designer to help build a product where investment insights become second nature.</p> <p>This is a high-agency architectural role for a tech-savvy generalist, not a static mockup factory. You will treat the production codebase as one of your canvas, shipping production grade HTML, CSS, and JavaScript next to engineers. We operate on the other side of the AI shift, where tools like Cursor, v0, and Claude unblock designers to act as exponential force multipliers. You will design next-generation paradigms for complex human-AI collaboration, defining how analysts orchestrate multiple autonomous agents, and even rewriting prompt frameworks and system instructions to shape the AI personality.</p> <p>By building our taste, opinions, and design decisions into the design system, we make it easier for everyone at Samaya to create high-quality work. That gives the design team more time to focus on product architecture, the long-term vision, and the decisions that have lasting impact instead of constantly responding to one-off feature requests or temporary fixes. We make deliberate tradeoffs that let the team move quickly while spending our time on structural improvements that continue to pay off. Over time, this helps the Sundial design language stay consistent and high quality across every touchpoint, from the product UI to presentations, documents, the website, and other brand assets.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Shape the user experience, owning what analysts need and how information hierarchy, interaction design, and typography make dense financial data intuitive, fast, and trustworthy</li> <li>Architect multi-agent interactions, designing workflows for human collaboration with AI agents and defining how users monitor, direct, and work with multiple agents at once</li> <li>Own Samaya AI's persona, shaping how the AI research collaborator thinks, communicates, and behaves so analysts experience it as intuitive, professional, and high integrity</li> <li>Ship production code, owning the UI and user experience end to end alongside engineers and product managers, with full accountability for what reaches analysts</li> <li>Drive product direction, proposing new concepts, questioning foundational assumptions, and making short-term design decisions that compound toward a clear product vision</li> <li>Own the customer loop, running weekly customer calls to hear friction firsthand and translating what you hear into shipped product changes</li> <li>Scale the Sundial design language, maintaining cohesion across the product, developing agent-ready skills and a <a href="http://design.md">design.md</a> architecture that engineers and AI agents build from, not just a component library</li> </ul> <h2>Experience</h2> <p><em>Required</em></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of professional product design experience with a strong portfolio of shipped digital products</li> <li>Hands-on experience writing production code directly in a codebase, with AI tools already central to your daily workflow</li> <li>Deep craft across typography, grid systems, color theory, and visual hierarchy, applied consistently across every surface and screen size a product touches</li> <li>A proven track record of taking vague, highly underspecified problems and independently carving them into concrete, shippable product features</li> <li>Direct experience building, maintaining, or scaling a design system and documenting component libraries and skills for team-wide use</li> <li>Experience running user interviews, synthesizing qualitative feedback, and translating customer pain points into shipped product changes that delivered measurable customer and business value</li> </ul> <p><em>Preferred</em></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with prompt engineering, multi-agent canvases, or interfaces that dynamically adapt to probabilistic AI behaviors</li> <li>Background designing for analytical or professional user bases such as financial analysts, researchers, lawyers, or clinicians, where precision and trust matter more than simplicity alone</li> <li>A track record building complex dashboards, analytical software, developer tools, or enterprise data platforms</li> <li>Experience documenting design patterns, rules, and components specifically optimized for AI agents to interpret and generate interfaces</li> <li>A track record extending design thinking across every touchpoint a brand and product meets its audience, with the same rigor and craft applied throughout</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>The cash compensation range for this role is $160,000 - $220,000.</p> <p>Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.</p> <p>Equity components may also be considered as part of the overall compensation package.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><strong>Health:</strong>&nbsp;Access comprehensive health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, flexible spending account (FSA), and short-term disability.</p> <p><strong>Wealth:</strong>&nbsp;Support for your long-term financial wellbeing with a 401(k) and pre-tax benefits (e.g. commuting).</p> <p><strong>Rest:</strong>&nbsp;Enjoy flexibility to rest and recharge as needed, with unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off).</p> <p><strong>Flexibility:</strong>&nbsp;Work flexibly with a hybrid setup — typically team members spend a minimum of three days in the office per week.</p> <p><strong>Travel:</strong>&nbsp;Grow and connect with a travel budget that encourages conference attendance, customer visits, and team gatherings.</p> <p><strong>Equipment:</strong>&nbsp;Create your ideal workspace with an office equipment allowance to set up what works best for you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Inclusive Hiring</h3> <p><strong>Interview Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to ensuring an equitable selection process for everyone and welcome applicants from varied backgrounds to enrich our team. If you require accommodations or adjustments during our recruitment process, please inform us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.</p> <p><strong>Visa Sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <h3>About Samaya</h3> <p><span class="discussion-id-3a5d6763-7931-802e-8d15-001ce8355746 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">Samaya AI builds Expert AI Agents for investment professionals, supporting high-stakes investment workflows across leading financial institutions. By combining finance-specific AI models with deep reasoning over institutional context and global markets, Samaya helps investors go from information to conviction. Samaya is deployed at enterprise scale across hedge funds, asset managers, and banks, including more than 12,000 professionals at one of the world's largest financial institutions. Built by a team from Google DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft, and Stanford with 100+ papers and 50k+ citations, it achieves 98% accuracy on financial reasoning tasks where generic LLMs reach 53%. Backed by leading AI investors including NVIDIA, Databricks Ventures, NEA, Eric Schmidt, and Yann LeCun, Samaya continues to advance the next generation of AI for investment professionals.</span></p> <h3>Our Operating Principles</h3> <p><strong>Put Users first.</strong> Our users rely on us to do their jobs. We exist because our users trust us to help them achieve their goals. In return for this trust users place in us, we keep their needs as our top priority.</p> <p><strong>Win as a collective.</strong> We are high achievers with a drive to succeed. We build strong bonds over this shared drive. We dive in to help when one of us needs it. We’re kind to each other and boost each other to succeed and grow professionally and personally. We build trust with each other by making commitments and consistently delivering on them. This trust means we genuinely support each other, embracing feedback as a tool for growth and improvement. We win by operating this way, as one team.</p> <p><strong>Focus and iterate quickly.</strong> Bias for action makes us build and learn quickly. Iterating fast requires clarity on what outcomes we are targeting and why. Prioritizing the important things, taking full ownership and initiative, making fast initial progress, and rapid iterations lead to the best outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Innovate Relentlessly.</strong> We pursue novel insights, challenging the status quo and reimagining how things are done. We aren’t attached to the past when improving our product and how we work in the future. We actively invest time in innovation, thinking “outside the box” to consistently raise our standards.</p> <p><strong>Prioritize Outcomes over Egos</strong>. We are committed not to a person, an idea, or an opinion but to continuously making progress to our goals. Sometimes, our goals are ambiguous; in those moments, we iterate, learn, and move on to the next inquiry. We ask the tough questions with kindness, dropping our egos in our pursuit of evidence. For our business goals, we learn from our users. For our scientific goals, our understanding is built through rigorous experimentation, research, and observation. For our personal goals, we embrace candid feedback and collaborative learning to guide our progress.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

Join us today and apply now!</p></div><h3>The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:</h3> <p>You will be building Moloco's mobile Ads SDK that enables publishers (app developers) to monetize their mobile applications. You may work directly with external customers and collaborate closely with our engineering teams.</p> <p>The Opportunity:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design, architect, and build a state-of-the-art Ads SDK for functionality for our customers.</li> </ul> <h3>How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or an equivalent technical degree</li> <li>5+ job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. improvement.</li> <li>Design, implement, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, data systems, and workflows that support Moloco’s products and customer experiences.</li> <li>Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clear technical solutions, balancing product impact, engineering quality, delivery timelines, and operational cost.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Data, ML, stakeholders and delivering high-quality results.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to make sound technical decisions in ambiguous situations and clearly communicate the rationale, trade-offs, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building products or platforms in digital advertising, machine learning, media, e-commerce, fintech, or analytics, and reporting capabilities into customer-facing products.</li> <li>Experience defining or improving reliability practices, including SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, backfill strategies, cost management, and incident response.</li> <li>Ability to simplify complex technical or operational concepts into clear product experiences, APIs, and workflows.</li> <li>Experience working in a global or multi-region environment, especially where customer needs, market dynamics, or regulations differ by region.</li> <li>Demonstrated success influencing technical direction across organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority.</li> <li>Experience building inclusive, collaborative teams and helping engineers develop their technical and leadership capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong id="docs-internal-guid-10b2a5c2-7fff-9123-b3ca-404b4268f3fb"></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We take
